tickets.title: Prepare Nadia Pebblefizz’s equity vesting and trading-window calendar
tickets.text: Prepare a practical equity vesting and trading-window calendar for Nadia Pebblefizz, separating Nadia-controlled from company-administered dates. Clarify quarterly RSU vesting, option-expiration sequencing, trading blackouts, and employer preclearance steps.

tickets.title: Prepare pre-window option exercise and sale analysis

tickets.evidence: For 2025-03-14, agreed pre-window option exercise/sale analysis covers next open trading window following current blackout, meaningful spread over strike, and Nadia weighing AMT exposure, share retention, and stock concentration.
